scientific_integrity: All general quantifiers are supported by elementary right-special-factor and complement-orbit arguments. Finite checks are illustrative, not infinite proofs. Nonuniversality of the individual Thue--Morse word and parity observations in earlier literature are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Only non-ultimately-periodic binary words with full factor language closed under exchanging letters; odd-length obstruction; no claim for other alphabets or symmetry-free words. The 2026 manuscript full text was not accessible for complete priority comparison; self-review is not independent.
title: Uniform odd-length group-complexity gaps for complement-symmetric binary words
